designationHistory.name: National Red Dirt Wildlife Management Preserve
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt set aside Weeks Act lands of the Kisatchie National Forest, Louisiana, as the National Red Dirt Wildlife Management Preserve.

authority.citation: Proclamation 2514, Sept. 27, 1941, 55 Stat. 1688 (under Act of Aug. 11, 1916, 39 Stat. 446, 476)
